FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: whipped {0_adj} mash
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} peeled thick — everything concentrates just under the skin — boiled in plenty of water that is then thrown out, and mashed with {1_plur} and {2_plur}. The flesh stays grey; the taste gives nothing away.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: {0_adj} fries
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: batons of {0_adj} left an hour in clear water, drained, then fried twice in {1_plur}. The first bath cleans, the second crisps. Salted with {2_plur} on the way out.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: {0_adj} rösti
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: raw grated {0_coll}, wrung out in a cloth until the blackened juice stops running, mixed with {2_plur} and seared into a cake in foaming {1_plur}. That juice is the only thing being driven off.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: {0_adj} gnocchi
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: a twice-boiled {0_adj} mash bound with {1_adj} flour and rolled into small ridged pillows. Poached until they float, then coated in melted {2_plur}.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: {0_adj} and leek soup
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} blanched in a first water that is thrown out, then cooked with {1_coll} in clean stock and finished with {2_plur} off the heat. Two waters: the rule allows no exception.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: {0_adj} and chickpea curry
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_coll} cubed and part-cooked apart, added late to {1_coll} simmering in a masala toasted with whole {2_plur}. They drink up the sauce and still hold on a spoon.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: sweet-and-sour {0_coll}
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: {0_adj} rounds salted to draw the water out, seared hard, then glazed with a {1_adj} vinegar and dried {2_plur}. The acid does double duty: it cleans and it wakes.

FlavorText.FlavorDef.label: {0_adj} cottage pie
FlavorText.FlavorDef.description: minced {1_coll} spread across the dish, covered with a {0_adj} mash beaten with {2_plur} and browned under the grill. The dish of colonies that can grow nothing else, and manage very well on it.
